item.text:
The likely fault is in [ContextReader](/app/lib/utils/prompt/context_reader.go:238): a canceled or expired password read returns from `waitForRead` without restoring the saved terminal state. [Close](/app/lib/utils/prompt/context_reader.go:278) also marks the reader closed without restoring it. In the MFA path, [an OTP password read uses a cancelable context](/app/lib/client/mfa.go:155), which explains why completing security key authentication can leave Bash with echo disabled.

The fix should restore the terminal on abandoned password reads, return restoration errors, leave the reader ready for subsequent reads, and make `Close` restore before closing. [stdin.go](/app/lib/utils/prompt/stdin.go:24) also needs the specified public `NotifyExit` function to close the singleton reader. A deadline must return an empty result and `context.DeadlineExceeded`. The main uncertainty is how to preserve an underlying password read that remains blocked after cancellation.

Existing prompt tests pass, but they cover restoration only after a later clean read. I recorded the diagnosis in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit project source or tests because this run’s specialist instructions restrict work to fault localization.
